rules.nonzero: called("deposit") and ok and arg(0) > 0 and ret == 0
rules.deposit_supply: called("deposit") and ok and post("totalSupply") != pre("totalSupply") + ret
rules.donate_assets: called("donate") and ok and post("totalAssets") != pre("totalAssets") + arg(0)
rules.deposit_assets: called("deposit") and ok and post("totalAssets") != pre("totalAssets") + arg(0)
rules.deposit_works: called("deposit") and reverted and (arg(0) > 0 and (pre("totalSupply") == 0 or wide(arg(0)) * pre("totalSupply") >= pre("totalAssets")))
rules.fair_mint: called("deposit") and ok and pre("totalSupply") > 0 and wide(ret) * pre("totalAssets") > wide(arg(0)) * pre("totalSupply")
rules.fair_floor: called("deposit") and ok and pre("totalSupply") > 0 and wide(ret + 1) * pre("totalAssets") <= wide(arg(0)) * pre("totalSupply")
rules.share_price: ok and pre("totalSupply") > 0 and post("totalSupply") > 0 and wide(post("totalAssets")) * pre("totalSupply") < wide(pre("totalAssets")) * post("totalSupply")
